slug: 2026-06-23 Implications of Zimbabwe’s National AI Strategy on Freedom of Expression Privacy and Access to Information

facts.fact: MISA Zimbabwe, a media-freedom body inside the country, published an analysis criticising the Zimbabwe National AI Strategy 2026-2030, including its proposed National Reality Check Platform for truth-verification, as lacking legal safeguards for freedom of expression.

systems.system: Section 164C of the Cyber and Data Protection Act (false data messages)

note: Says s164C has been used against journalists but names no person, date or case, so no penalty fact.
